title: Relation preserved outside scratch addresses
statement: Let $W$ be a word size, let $Z$ specify a layout with $F$ local variables per frame, stack bound $Q$, and space limit, and let $\sigma$ be a state. Suppose $m$ stores the encoded constants $1,0,-1$ and pool indices $n\le Z.\mathrm{disp}$ at their designated addresses, stores the stack address for frame pointer $q$, stores $\sigma_{\mathrm{loc}}(x)$ at stack address $q+x$ for every $x<F$, and stores $\sigma_{\mathrm{mem}}(a)$ at address $a$ for every $a<Z.\mathrm{lim}.\mathrm{space}$. If $m'$ agrees with $m$ outside the scratch addresses $-21,-15,-17,-19,-13$, and $-(23+4j)$ for $0\le j\le 2F$, then $m'$ satisfies the same storage relation for $Z,\sigma,q$.
hypotheses_covered: Agreement of $m'$ and $m$ outside the specified scratch-address set
